claim: The person stated on 2026-10-04 that the two filter-turret shutters, Micro-Manager devices Turret1Shutter and Turret2Shutter, are closed when their State property is "0".
validity_conditions: A recollection, not a reading: no read-back of either shutter in a closed state is recorded on this stand, and the abort that closes them to this value (35c5d6d) has run on mock only. Falsifier: on the stand, a shutter seen closed whose State reads anything but "0". KNOWLEDGE, NOT POLICY: which value means closed is a fact about the device; that software may write it, and only on an abort, is the person's exemption of 2026-10-04 in plan.md 4.6.8 and not this entry's to grant.

valid_until.event: A recorded read-back of each shutter's State with the shutter seen closed on the stand; the E1 entry from it supersedes this one.
